_about: Public-domain William Carvosso (1750-1834), Cornish Methodist class-leader for sixty years, for the Word Hoard: his memoir written by himself and edited by his son, The Efficacy of Faith in the Atonement of Christ (London: J. Mason, 1836, second and third editions) and its American edition, The Great Efficacy of Simple Faith (New York, 1837 and 1845), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
